title: 十一点五十分的挂号信  (Ten Minutes to Twelve)

segments.t: Inside at the front desk at eleven fifty, Manager Zhou straightens his clean blue tie while Qing and Mei watch the clock—right as the postman leaves a thick white envelope on the counter. Listen first.
小晴，今天我的领带怎么样？一滴橙汁都没有！
笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
我把蓝色行李箱放在树下志豪桌子边了。
茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
小晴，今天我的领带怎么样？一滴橙汁都没有！
'Qing, how does my tie look today? Not a single drop of orange juice!'
笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
'Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.'
有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
'Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!'
说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
'Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!'
我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
'I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?'
邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
'The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.'
房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
'Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.'
十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
'Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!'
说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
'Right you are. Paperwork can wait—set it beside the ledger for now.'
我把蓝色行李箱放在树下志豪桌子边了。
'I placed the blue suitcase right beside Hao's table under the tree.'
茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
'And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!'
听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
'Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

That thick envelope with the red property stamp sits unopened beside the ledger as the street clock tower begins chiming twelve. Let's step out to the gate next time. See you next time.
回头见！
